qualification: Every Storybook story and desktop/mobile handbook passed before selection.

screenshots.alt: Worker taskboard showing capacity and requests grouped by their current state.
screenshots.caption: The real worker taskboard with sample local requests. Select a request to inspect its conversation and progress; use Metrics, History and Settings to inspect and configure the worker.

screenshots.alt: Shared Feature Request authoring in the worker, with request instructions and the Prepare request action.
screenshots.caption: The shared-request entry screen with example instructions. The next step lets you review the template, approved scope and readiness before publishing.

screenshots.alt: Worker Metrics with current capacity, configured token allowance, resources and execution activity.
screenshots.caption: Metrics in the real worker UI with deterministic sample measurements. Worker process resources, host observations and the configured allowance are separate; these are not live account balances.

screenshots.alt: Feature Request review with the accepted goal, changed files, required checks and the next human action.
screenshots.caption: The real review workspace with a fictional verified candidate and a policy requiring human acceptance. Recording acceptance is separate from merging the change.

screenshots.alt: Worker settings with provider connections and navigation to repositories, tool access and consumption settings.
screenshots.caption: Settings in the real worker UI, using sample configuration. Keep credentials local to the worker machine.
